standard_prerequisites.name: The fusion product of cyclic graded modules, defined through the associated graded of the tensor product with respect to the filtration by the powers of a parameter
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section 4.1, in which the fusion product is set up before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the product in which the annihilation is asserted.

standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of the operator acting on the tensor product of the factors with the product of the shifted operators acting on the generators
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source line 568 as a pointer to the lemma labelled f1 (a navigation-pointer stub)
standard_prerequisites.use: Computes the action of the twisted operator on the class of the tensor of the generators.

core_obligations: Choose parameters and the associated graded: the proof picks distinct complex parameters and works in the associated graded of the tensor product with respect to the induced filtration (proof lines 567-568)

Compute the operator: using the lemma labelled f1 it writes down the action of the twisted operator on the class of the tensor product of the generators as the tensor of the shifted operators applied to the generators, in the appropriate step of the filtration, with a labelled displayed equality inside the proof (proof lines 568-573)
Conclude from the definition: the displayed equality together with the definition of the fusion product gives the assertion (proof lines 574-575)
proof_roadmap: 取互异复数 z_1,…,z_m 与相应的滤过，在 gr V 中计算 (x⊗t^{s_1+…+s_m}) 作用在 (v_1⊗…⊗v_m)+F^{-1}V 上的像；由 lemma f1 它等于 ((x⊗(t-z_1)^{s_1}…(t-z_m)^{s_m})v_1⊗…⊗v_m) + F^{s_1+…+s_m-1}V。
由各因子上的零化假设该像落在相应滤过步内为零，再按融合积的定义即得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that if a fixed element of the Lie algebra twisted by a high enough power of the parameter annihilates each generator of the factors, then the element twisted by the sum of the exponents annihilates the fusion product (author lemma at source lines 559-565, label f2). The proof (source lines 566-576) passes to the associated graded of the tensor product, uses the article's lemma f1 to compute the action of the twisted operator on the class of the tensor of the generators, and reads the conclusion off the definition of the fusion product (proof lines 567-575). The computation in the associated graded is the content. H2.
